commits.message:
Add uncovered_gaps for stretches nobody is working

Takes the spans worked in a day and an opening span, and returns one label per uncovered stretch. A worked span outside opening hours raises ValueError.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.hourglass/gaps.py:
# owner: platform
"""Find opening hours that nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans


# ---
def uncovered_gaps(
    worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span
) -> List[str]:
    """One label for each stretch nobody is working."""
    spans = merge_spans(worked)
    check_inside(spans, opening)
    stretches = gaps_in(spans, opening)
    return [gap_label(stretch) for stretch in stretches]


# ---
def check_inside(spans: List[Span], opening: Span) -> None:
    """Raise ValueError when a span is out of hours."""
    for span in spans:
        early = span.start < opening.start
        late = span.end > opening.end
        if early or late:
            text = format_span(span)
            raise ValueError(f"outside opening: {text}")


# ---
def gaps_in(spans: List[Span], opening: Span) -> List[Span]:
    """Stretches of opening hours that no span covers."""
    opens = [opening.start] + [span.end for span in spans]
    closes = [span.start for span in spans] + [opening.end]
    pairs = zip(opens, closes)
    kept = [pair for pair in pairs if pair[0] < pair[1]]
    return [Span(*pair) for pair in kept]


# ---
def gap_label(stretch: Span) -> str:
    """Text such as gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)."""
    text = format_span(stretch)
    return f"gap {text} ({stretch.minutes} min)"
after.tests/test_gaps.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.gaps import uncovered_gaps

OPEN = Span(540, 1080)


class UncoveredGapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_between_two_shifts(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 720), Span(780, 1080)]
        labels = uncovered_gaps(worked, OPEN)
        expected = ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_nobody_working(self):
        labels = uncovered_gaps([], OPEN)
        expected = ["gap 09:00-18:00 (540 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_fully_covered(self):
        labels = uncovered_gaps([OPEN], OPEN)
        self.assertEqual(labels, [])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        labels = uncovered_gaps([Span(600, 900)], OPEN)
        expected = [
            "gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
            "gap 15:00-18:00 (180 min)",
        ]
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_overlaps_count_once(self):
        worked = [
            Span(540, 700),
            Span(650, 720),
            Span(780, 1080),
        ]
        labels = uncovered_gaps(worked, OPEN)
        expected = ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_touching_spans_leave_no_gap(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 720), Span(720, 1080)]
        labels = uncovered_gaps(worked, OPEN)
        self.assertEqual(labels, [])

    def test_span_outside_opening_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            uncovered_gaps([Span(480, 600)], OPEN)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            uncovered_gaps([Span(1000, 1140)], OPEN)
